heldout_data: c7-added samples only; c6 prefix excluded
note: The transport-map coefficients were frozen from c6 before this c7-only heldout validation. c7-added samples are not used in the coefficient fit.
interpretation: The frozen periodic shear materially flattens the dominant H0-Omega_scf ridge on heldout c7-added samples. Residual RIMS coupling, especially q_H-rims_alpha_U, remains non-negligible and is intentionally left for c8p1 diagnostics rather than fitted away post hoc.
claim_boundary: Sampler-geometry validation only; not a cosmological posterior result and not evidence of model preference.
